notes.title: Introducing "Ludus Mortis"
notes.content:
Hi, I want to introduce you the new game I'm currently working on, [b]Ludus Mortis[/b].

Like "Inferno - Beyond the 7th Circle", "Ludus Mortis" is First Person Dungeon Crawler, but this time is party-based.

It's set in Rome, during the 4th Century AD; an evil force has been summoned by corrupted members of the Roman Senate and now the undead are taking control over the Eternal City.

In this chaos, a Ludus (School of gladiators) has continued to train gladiators and is ready to put an end to the shadow that prevails over Rome.

The Steam page is available: you can check it for more info about the game and to add Ludus Mortis to your [b]Wishlist[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197650/Ludus_Mortis/] Ludus Mortis on Steam[/url]

Coming Q2 2023

[previewyoutube=b-tqB3Dh_mE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Version 1.0.16 : New post-game Boss and more
notes.content:
Version 1.0.16 is now live.

I was planning to release a new post-game campaign, but I wasn't fully satisfied with the result so I preferred to move all new contents into the original campaign.

This new update, one year after the game's release, contains precisely these new contents:

[list]
[*]  New Boss: Beelzebub. Appears in new games if you have killed the main campaign boss at least once. Beelzebub is a very powerful (but optional) boss; you can find it near the Cathedral.
[*] New enemies: Bears and Armored Bears.
[*] New items: Anctient Tomes, which increase the level of some skills.
[*] New hazards: swarms of flies (a "gift" from Beelzebub)
[*] Changes have been made to some enemies attributes (the first monsters will be slightly easier)
[*] Increased cost for upgrading attributes with a value that is over 20
[/list]

notes.title: Mac Version + Update 1.0.14
notes.content:
Big update: Mac Version is now available!

Also, a lot of improvements and fixes for the game:
[list]
[*] New "Survival Mode: Beginner" difficulty available: you will recover more HP and SP while resting and your Hunger and Thirst level will decrease slower. 
[*] The "Don't bother" perk now works correctly
[*] The "Open Wounds" status is more likely to happens
[*] If you build a campfire in a dungeon you will now read the correct text
[*] Increased Skill XP gained for the Survivalism Skill
[*] Reduced the amount of Metal Scraps needed to upgrade weapons for higher levels
[*] Fixed the error that prevents the "Magic Fire" spell to be casted in some squares
[*] Some enemies (like vampires) now will be blinded for some rounds by your torchlight (or the equivalent spell)
[*] The spell that bring you back to the Shelter now works correctly even if you save on an old slot
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.13 is now live
notes.content:
Changelog:

[list]
[*] On "Hell" difficulty mode every enemy will have a random boost (SPD, STR, Fire RES, Poison RES, Cause Fear, Saving Throws, ToHit chance, Armor)
[*] You can now remove skill points in the character creation phase, so if you misplace one point you don't have to redo the entire build
[*] The Doppelganger will boost his stats according to your magic skills too, instead of using only your STR and weapon damage
[*] New Trait "Herbivorous" (increased Food and Thirst level eating fruits and vegetables)
[*] New Background "Child of the Wilderness" (start the game with some supplies)
[*] Fixed the "Open Wound" status (now if you finish a fight with less than 10% HP you have a chance to trigger it)
[*] Reduced XP obtained killing the Doppelganger
[*] Changed how Fitness and Willpower saving throws for enemies are calculated on higher difficulties
[*] Reduces Skill XP obtained using twin weapons and fists
[*] Fixed key binding for Combat
[*] New option: "Remove flashes on critical hits"
[*] New option: "Remove fog" to increase performances on older devices
[*] Fixed the "Drain" and "Entangled" statuses that where not triggered
[*] Fixed the "starred armors with no upgrades" bug
[*] New Crating Skill perks "Masterpiece Maker I & II": you can now create starred armor pieces
[*] Reduced the armor value of every piece to prevent reaching the armor level cap too soon
[*] Reduced the increase of armor value given by the Light and Heavy armor skills
[*] Slightly reduced Skill XP obtained with any weapon
[/list]

notes.title: What do you want to see in the next updates?
notes.content:
A little update to inform you on what I'm currently working on.

In the next update of[b] Inferno - Beyond the 7th Circle[/b] you will find some new settings (like the option to remove flashes after a critical hit or to remove the fog to increase the frame rate on slower machines) and some balancing to the game mechanics (I've reduced the Skill XP gained for Unarmed and Twin weapons, reduced the armor bonus given by Light and Heavy Armor skill and added two new perks for the Crafting skill). The update will be published in a couple of weeks.

Also, I'm working on[b] a new campaign [/b] that will be available (for every one that have completed the main game) in the next few months. And it will be [b]free[/b] because I really hate DLCs, microtransactions and stuff like that.

That said, what kind of content, option, game mode or fix do you want to see in the next updates?

And remember to join my Discord server here https://discord.gg/RfUNc8w to give me your feedbacks and suggestions.

PS: Are you enjoying the game? Please write a review on the Steam page, it's really important to me ;)

notes.title: The game is too hard? Let's make it harder!
notes.content:
While some people consider [b]Inferno [/b] a really hard game, there are other players that have managed to master the game mechanics so well that may want something more. So, a new challenge is coming for them: the new [b]Hardcore Mode[/b].

Beating the game you will unlock the Hardcore Mode ([b]Permadeath[/b]) in the character creation screen. In this mode, you can't save or load the game and if you die the character is lost forever. The game will be automatically saved every few seconds, so mistakes can't be undone.

This option will be available in the upcoming update, together with the [b]Linux [/b]version of the game.

notes.title: Release date
notes.content:
[b]Inferno - Beyond The 7th Circle [/b] will be released on Walpurgisnacht (April 30, 2021).

The choice of date is not accidental: [b]Walpurgis night[/b] is the "night of the witches", the night in which demons awaken and in which humans light immense fires to ward off evil.

The battle for survival begins on April 30th.
